GenAiPlugin.description: Selected when the user wants to update patient phone, email, or other allowed demographic fields. Do not ask the user to enable write capability.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Call Enigma_Update_Patient_Field with the patient Id, field API name, new value, and the user's exact request as userAsk.
If status is HELD, tell the user to Authorize in Enigma Decisions and retry. Never ask them to enable write capability.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Update allowed patient demographic fields. Enigma governs write authorization inside the action.
